text: monthGrid.draw receives an exclusive first-day-of-next-month end. It draws requested months, then decrements endDate to the final selected day and extends separate displayStartDate/displayEndDate to adjacent printed weeks. The fetch end advances one day to include the last displayed day. Title formatting uses the selected month endpoints, not the extended week range. Preserve these inclusive/exclusive and mutation contracts in nearby print changes. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Keep requested months distinct from the printed item fetch interval
